settings.heading: Types of Subscriptions
settings.row_content:
There are several subscription plans differentiated by publication. Subscriptions are annual but are subject to the periodicity of each of the brands you can subscribe to.

Annual Home delivery: Delivery to the address you wish and specify. The entire year is paid in a single payment. Does not include cover gifts.

Ebono: Collection at store. The entire year is paid in a single payment. Includes cover gifts and extras that the magazine carries.

Monthly: Delivery to the address you wish and specify. Paid month to month. Does not include cover gifts.

All subscriptions can be cancelled before the expiry date depending on their periodicity.

settings.heading: How can I subscribe?
settings.row_content:
You can subscribe to our print editions from this website,

For collective or corporate subscriptions you can call 983 008 401 or send an e-mail to subscriptions@condenast.in

To subscribe to our digital editions, you can do so from the main platforms available in the market: Apple, Zinio, Google Play, Google Play Store and Press Reader.

settings.heading: When does my subscription begin?
settings.row_content:
When you choose a plan, for all subscriptions purchased before the 10th of the current month inclusive, your first issue will be the next published number.

For subscriptions that are paid from the 11th of the current month onwards, your first issue will be two months later.

settings.heading: Can I request an invoice?
settings.row_content: You can request your invoice directly through the website or also on our subscriber service phones.

settings.heading: Can I temporarily receive the magazine at another address?
settings.row_content:
You can request a temporary address change in your customer area within the website.

Remember that you have to make this change before the 9th of the previous month for it to be effective.

settings.heading: How do I claim a non-received issue?
settings.row_content: If for any reason you do not receive your issue, please contact us and we will try to expedite the receipt of the issue as soon as possible.

settings.heading: Can I buy back issues?
settings.row_content: You can buy back issues of Vogue, AD , GQ and CNTraveler magazines in print version through Amazon and all magazines in digital version through our digital platforms App Store (Apple), Zinio and Play Store (Google Play Store). Please consult us by sending an e-mail to: subscriptions@condenast.in.

settings.heading: Are there special subscriptions for companies, public institutions, groups, universities, etc.?
settings.row_content: There are special subscription plans for companies, public institutions or educational centres. Please consult us and we will offer you an ad-hoc proposal according to your needs. You can contact through subscriptions@condenast.in.

settings.heading: How to send subscriptions outside India?
settings.row_content:
You can do so by choosing the International option at the beginning of the page.

The transit periods of the magazines vary depending on the destination and weight of the magazine.
